caseNameFull: CLEVENGER, TRUSTEE IN BANKRUPTCY v. CHANEY SAME v. LYLE SAME v. NICHOLS
syllabus: Appeals from the Circuit Court of Appeals affirming orders and decrees of the bankruptcy court dismissed for want of jurisdiction without opinion on authority of Chapman v. Bowen, 207 U. S. 89.1
summary: APPEALS PROM THE CIRCUIT COURT OP APPEALS POR THE SIXTH CIRCUIT AND APPLICATIONS POR WRITS OP CERTIORARI.
attorneys: Mr. E. E. Clevenger and Mr. Cook Danford, for appellants., Mr. A. H. Mitchell for appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

Appeals dismissed for want of jurisdiction. Applications for certiorari denied. Chapman, Trustee, &c., v. Bowen, 207 U. S. 89.
